description: Search the romankryvolapov.com engineering blog: articles on Java, Kotlin, Android, Spring, microservices, gRPC, Kubernetes, databases, and running large language models locally (llama.cpp, LoRA fine-tuning, RAG, prompt engineering). Every article exists in English, Ukrainian, Russian and Bulgarian, and results come in one language: set lang to the user’s language, otherwise it is guessed from the query. Returns matching articles with snippets and URLs; read one with fetch, passing its id.

lang.description: Language of the articles to return: en, uk, ru or bg — normally the user’s language. Without it: English for a query in Latin script, Ukrainian, Russian or Bulgarian for one in Cyrillic.

query.description: Free-text search query, in any of the site’s four languages.

name: search

id.description: Article id for fetch: its canonical URL.

snippet.description: The passage that matched the query.

title: Search the blog
